concepts.label: Import Process (Sync Gateway)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the page's own primary subject ('The import process is a key part of mobile convergence'); the registry has sgw:import-docs-setting (the boolean toggling participation) and sgw:import-filter (the per-document predicate) but no concept for the mechanism itself - how a non-Sync-Gateway mutation is detected, run through the Sync Function under an admin identity, and turned into mobile metadata

relations.subject: sgw:custom-collection
relations.evidence: You need Couchbase Lite 3.1+ and Sync Gateway 3.1+ to use `custom` Scopes and Collections.

notable_absence.finding: The round brief hypothesized this page would state or imply a dependency on protocol:dcp (DCP) as the transport by which Sync Gateway detects non-Sync-Gateway mutations. It does not - the string 'DCP' does not appear anywhere on this page. The page describes only what happens once a mutation is detected (Sync Function run under admin context, import_filter evaluation) and never names the underlying detection/streaming mechanism. This is a genuine absence worth flagging: the page that most needed to confirm or deny a DCP dependency for import processing does not mention DCP at all, in either this file or its near-duplicate content embedded in sync-with-couchbase-server.md.

cross_component_finding: Import processing's use of an admin-level Sync Function context, which turns requireAccess()/requireUser()/requireRole() into no-ops, is a precise mechanical link to round 27's access-control vocabulary (sgw:require-access-cmd, sgw:require-user-cmd, sgw:require-role-cmd) - all three require*() concepts are already promoted, and this page adds a fourth execution context (alongside normal writes and Admin-API writes) in which they are bypassed rather than enforced.
cross_product_finding: The custom Scopes/Collections requirement ties Couchbase Lite's own version (3.1+) to Sync Gateway's (3.1+) as a joint gate, with an explicit Capella-App-Services fallback note: 'If you're using Capella App Services or Sync Gateway releases that are older than version 3.1, you won't be able to access `custom` Scopes and Collections. To use Couchbase Lite 3.1+ with these older versions, you can use the `default` Collection as a backup option.' This is a three-product version-compatibility statement (CBL, Sync Gateway, Capella App Services) on a single setting.
